description: Urban Green DaMS: Hydraulic Conductivity Function Data is a data set deposited in ORDA - The University of Sheffield Research Data Catalogue and Repository by its authors Simon De-Ville, Zhangjie Peng. This dataset is a complete record of all data compiled as part of a series of three infiltration column tests to identify the unsaturated hydraulic conductivity of a bioretention media. The experimental work was conducted at The University of Sheffield, Sheffield, UK, from December 2019 to February 2021 (15 months). Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 792382 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
